estimand: working smoothed mean/covariance of observed raw VAS under noninformative observation assumptions; selection unresolved
scale: raw VAS 0-10; minutes unchanged; no zero or E/T imputation
engine: fdapace 0.6.0 Sparse local-linear smoothing and CE scores
bandwidth_rationale: engineering working smoothing scales in minutes; sensitivity reported, no optimal bandwidth or cross-validation selection claim

bootstrap.role: exploratory stability, not calibrated confidence bands

simulation.random_sparse: 8 random distinct grid points per subject
simulation.independent_dropout: uniform integer last minute from 10 to 20
simulation.engineering_gate: all fits finite and positive-semidefinite fitted covariance; no coverage or phenotype acceptance claim

output_policy: no E/T cell replacement or individual post-stop reconstruction; CE scores are model-derived estimates; no prediction claim
fve_policy: compute denominator from all positive eigenvalues of smoothed covariance; do not normalize only the first four
subspace_metric: weighted QR orthonormalization before principal angles because package functions need not be exactly trapezoid-orthogonal
